title: How I Reversed My Hair Loss: Bryan Johnson's multi-layer hair regrowth protocol
summary: Bryan Johnson describes how he regrew a full head of hair and cut gray by about half by age 46. His stack combines nutrition, a custom topical Rx, a red light cap and oral minoxidil, with blood monitoring of DHT. He reports PRP/PRF failed for him and stresses monitoring side effects.

principles.text: Start a hair health protocol early, before loss is visible.
principles.quote: Consider starting a hair health protocol before you can visibly detect loss.

principles.text: Hair needs adequate protein and key micronutrients, which the Blueprint stack covers.
principles.quote: You’ll want to make sure you’re getting adequate protein, Omega-3 fatty acids, Biotin (Vitamin B7), Vitamin C, Vitamin D, Vitamin E, Iron, Zinc and Biotin.

principles.text: Apply 1 mL of a topical daily and massage the scalp for 1-2 minutes to stimulate blood flow.
principles.quote: I use a topical solution, 1 mL applied to my scalp each morning (before bed is ok too).

principles.text: Monitor blood markers: twice-daily topical pushed DHT too low (5.8 ng/dL), so he went back to once daily and retests in 90 days.
principles.quote: my recent blood results showed my DHT levels too low at 5.8 ng/dL which can create side effects. I’m back at 1x daily and will retest my blood in 90 days.

principles.text: Budget baseline is topical minoxidil 5%; he adds oral minoxidil (3.75 mg/day) and a red light cap.
principles.quote: If you’re on a budget or just want a basic solution, you can try out Minoxidil 5%.

principles.text: PRP/PRF gave him almost no benefit after 12 months; share experiments openly, stay humble and monitor side effects.
principles.quote: After diligently doing it for 12 months, we saw nearly no benefit.
